# Game Idea: Pixel Runner

A simple side‑scrolling endless runner on an HTML canvas. The player controls a small square that automatically moves forward and can jump to avoid randomly generated obstacles (bars, spikes). The canvas scrolls left, creating the illusion of motion. **Lose condition:** colliding with any obstacle ends the game.

<content>
1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5:   const w = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
6:   const h = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
7:   // Player
8:   const player = {x:50, y:h-30, w:20, h:20, vy:0, jumpStrength:-8};
9:   const gravity = 0.4;
10:   // Obstacles
11:   const obstacles = [];
12:   let spawnTimer = 0;
13:   const spawnInterval = 90; // frames
14:   let speed = 3;
15:   let running = true;
16:   function reset(){
17:     player.y = h-30; player.vy=0; obstacles.length=0; spawnTimer=0; speed=3; running=true;
18:   }
19:   function gameOver(){
20:     running=false;
21:     ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
22:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
23:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
24:     ctx.font='24px sans-serif';
25:     ctx.fillText('Game Over - Press Space to Restart', w/2-180, h/2);
26:   }
27:   function spawnObstacle(){
28:     const type = Math.random()<0.5?'bar':'spike';
29:     const o = {x:w, w:20, type};
30:     if(type==='bar'){
31:       o.h = 30; o.y = h - o.h;
32:     } else {
33:       o.h = 20; o.y = h - o.h;
34:     }
35:     obstacles.push(o);
36:   }
37:   function update(){
38:     if(!running) return;
39:     // player physics
40:     player.vy += gravity;
41:     player.y += player.vy;
42:     if(player.y > h - player.h){player.y = h - player.h; player.vy=0;}
43:     // obstacles
44:     spawnTimer++;
45:     if(spawnTimer > spawnInterval){spawnObstacle(); spawnTimer=0;}
46:     for(let i=obstacles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
47:       const o = obstacles[i];
48:       o.x -= speed;
49:       // collision
50:       if(o.x < player.x+player.w && o.x+o.w > player.x &&
51:          o.y < player.y+player.h && o.y+o.h > player.y){
52:         gameOver();
53:         return;
54:       }
55:       if(o.x+o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i,1);
56:     }
57:     // increase speed gradually
58:     speed += 0.001;
59:   }
60:   function draw(){
61:     // sky gradient background
62:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
63:     grad.addColorStop(0,'#87CEEB'); // sky blue
64:     grad.addColorStop(1,'#FFFFFF');
65:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
66:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
67:     // ground
68:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
69:     ctx.fillRect(0, h-20, w, 20);
70:     // player (rounded square)
71:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
72:     ctx.beginPath();
73:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h/2);
74:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.w/2, player.y + player.h/2, player.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
75:     ctx.fill();
76:     // obstacles
77:     obstacles.forEach(o=>{
78:       if(o.type==='spike'){
79:         ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4500'; // orange red
80:         ctx.beginPath();
81:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
82:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w/2, o.y);
83:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
84:         ctx.closePath();
85:         ctx.fill();
86:       } else {
87:         ctx.fillStyle = '#8B0000'; // dark red bar
88:         ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,o.h);
89:       }
90:     });
91:   }
92:   function loop(){
93:     update();
94:     draw();
95:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
96:   }
97:   // audio setup
98:   const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
99:   const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
100:   function playBeep(freq,dur){
101:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
102:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
103:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
104:     osc.connect(gain);
105:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
106:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1,audioCtx.currentTime);
107:     osc.start();
108:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
109:   }
110:   // input
111:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
112:     if(e.code==='Space'){
113:       if(!running) reset();
114:       if(player.vy===0){
115:         player.vy=player.jumpStrength;
116:         playBeep(440,0.1); // jump sound
117:       }
118:     }
119:   });
120:   canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(player.vy===0){player.vy=player.jumpStrength;playBeep(440,0.1);}});
121:   // modify gameOver to play sound
122:   const originalGameOver = gameOver;
123:   function gameOver(){
124:     playBeep(150,0.3); // game over sound
125:     originalGameOver();
126:   }
127:   loop();
128: })();

(End of file - total 128 lines)
</content>
